build: DevEco Studio 26.0.0.851 debug signed, HarmonyOS API 26

checks.ssh_isolated_openssh_and_password_fixtur: passed with encrypted key, host key confirmation and mismatch, DSH HTTP and WebSocket, process reuse and cleanup
checks.relay_original_noise_vectors_and_respond: passed with actual DshClient RPC, fragmented follow, replay refusal, browser and pairing fixtures, and pinned self-hosted server sign-in, registration and revocation
checks.attachments_embedded_runtime: passed with denied hardlink fallback fixture, image delivery and history, text model fallback, session-scoped document reads and cross-session denial
checks.native_publication_linux_arm64_node_24_2: passed for attachments, workspace and session files, including no-replace, invalid paths and symlink refusal

acceptance_limits: No HarmonyOS device was connected. Installation, picker and camera UI, ScanKit, ArkWeb and native filesystem fallback on the phone remain unverified.
The live tests used isolated hosts and synthetic model providers. Hosted relay login and PTY over a real encrypted relay deployment remain unverified.
SSH requires a POSIX host with dsh web and TCP forwarding. Passwords and private keys are entered per connection.
The relay transport supports image attachments. LAN, WebRTC and TURN are outside this implementation. There is no local system shell.

The embedded model file tool reads UTF-8 documents attached to its own session. Inline images are capped at 12 MiB per send after conversion. Attachment gallery thumbnails and queued attachment recovery remain incomplete.
